subject.title: Gateway silently skips channel initialization on plugin/runtime mismatch or missing module files

question: What startup contract should configured channel plugin failures use when the plugin is discovered but fails before channel registration?
rationale: The narrow bug is missing channel-level auditability, but fail-fast startup, warn-and-continue behavior, hot reload, and performance caching all affect compatibility and operator expectations.

options.title: Add channel startup audit
options.body: Warn-and-continue remains the default, but startup reports configured channels attempted, loaded, and failed with plugin diagnostic reasons when available.

options.title: Fail fast for configured channels
options.body: Gateway readiness would fail or stay unavailable when a configured channel plugin is incompatible or unloadable, giving a stronger signal at higher upgrade risk.

options.title: Split broader asks
options.body: Keep this issue focused on startup diagnostics and track hot reload, API timeout severity, and startup performance as separate product decisions.

recommendation.title: Add channel startup audit
recommendation.body: Warn-and-continue remains the default, but startup reports configured channels attempted, loaded, and failed with plugin diagnostic reasons when available.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent gateway startup and performance work makes this the best available owner for the warn-and-continue versus fail-fast contract choice.
